steps.title: Define Project Identity
steps.description: Configure application Metadata, selecting the package identifier com.animmagic.app and app label AnimMagic.

steps.title: Configure Build Architecture
steps.description: Create the root build.gradle configurations targeting Android SDK 34, specifying AGP 8.3.2, Gradle 8.5, and enabling Java 8 compatibility configurations.

steps.title: Design Manifest Specifications
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml mapping, targeting custom Material themes, setting standard launcher intents, and declaring portrait locks for UI stability.

steps.title: Establish Master UI Layout
steps.description: Define the activity_main.xml file with custom top-header tabs, control configurations, custom scroll groups, and dynamic container layouts.

steps.title: Create Vector Drawing Models
steps.description: Program standard data wrappers for drawing strokes capturing individual Path values, Paint colors, and drawing widths for precision vector calculations.

steps.title: Implement Touch Canvas Controller
steps.description: Create the Flipbook drawing canvas module programmatically tracking Touch gestures, active coordinate drawings, and path updates.

steps.title: Establish Onion Skin Rendering Layers
steps.description: Program custom drawing loops rendering past animations transparently in the background, matching precise onion skin standard mechanics.

steps.title: Build Frame Playback Engines
steps.description: Construct high performance playback cycles inside dynamic background threads using custom handlers and adjustable playback Framerates (FPS).

steps.title: Assemble Physics Canvas Engines
steps.description: Implement interactive particle engines generating beautiful falling sandboxes, complete with customizable gravity constants and collision points.

steps.title: Implement Preset Tween Evaluators
steps.description: Implement classical Object animations, setting up translation indices, custom scales, rotation sets, and fade capabilities.

steps.title: Integrate Core Action Listeners
steps.description: Establish action buttons binding frame updates, canvas deletions, sliders configuration modifications, and dynamic interface switches.

steps.title: Optimize Drawing Memory Allocation
steps.description: Validate and build memory-efficient vector deep clones to preserve drawing fidelity during intensive timeline playbacks without creating OOM loops.

steps.title: Validate Namespace Integrity
steps.description: Verify XML layouts, standard schemas, and manifest namespaces to ensure strict build environmental compliance.

steps.title: Building AnimMagic
steps.description: Trigger final compilation routines creating the standalone AnimMagic package.
